prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied original Nine Dragon Fire game VFX sprite sheet. Produce a refined version of THIS SAME ANIMATION, preserving its identity. EXACT same 4 columns x 3 rows, 12 equal square cells in row-major time order, identical cell anchors and original framing, no grid lines. Keep the large VERTICAL intertwined nine Chinese fire dragons, recognizable dragon heads with horns, whiskers, snouts, long curling bodies rising out of a sacred ground ring. Preserve the substantial ritual silhouette and visual mass of the original; do NOT replace it with a pinwheel, radial swirl, abstract flames, tiny glyphs or nine identical spokes. Keep original orange/vermilion/gold palette and fine detailed fantasy illustration. Refine ONLY clarity and staged energy: remove muddy continuous orange fog BETWEEN the dragons so their heads and bodies can be distinguished; clean translucent edges; retain bright gold rims and warm darker fire-body interiors, avoid all-white clipped bodies. Frames 1-3: low golden ring, initial dragons gathering with crisp heads emerging. Frames 4-6: large dragons rising and intertwining vertically, full impressive silhouette and readable negative spaces. Frame7: dragons poised together, not yet full flash. Frame8 (row2 col4): strong localized white-gold impact at ground center, WITH the dragon heads and bodies remaining readable around it, no huge white opaque disk. Frame9: remaining dragon silhouettes dissolve from tips into embers. Frames10-11: diminishing curved dragon trails and ring fragments, clean transparent gaps. Frame12: only a few faint embers. Keep all frames centered over same ground anchor; no camera motion or unrelated added elements. Preserve 4:3 sheet aspect; aim at 2048x1536 with 512px cells if possible, no resampling of original disguised as detail. Real alpha-transparent background, no checkerboard painted in, no black background, no words or watermark. This is a conservative polish of the reference identity, not a redesign.

Edit target is this 4x3 12-frame Nine Dragon Fire animation sheet. Make a targeted CLEANUP, preserve exact 1448x1086 canvas and exact 4x3 cells and registered ground-ring centers. Preserve the nine detailed Chinese dragon heads, horns, whiskers and coiling golden bodies and original vertical ritual silhouette in FRAMES 1 through 8; do not shrink the dragons or turn them into a pinwheel. Crucial change across ALL frames: remove 70 percent of the soft ORANGE FOG / smoke BETWEEN the thin bright dragon bodies, leaving actual alpha-transparent dark gaps; the dragons themselves stay bright and crisply outlined, not faint. Preserve sharp white-gold face/scale details. The background must be real alpha transparent. Crucial cleanup of LAST ROW ONLY: frame9 (bottom left) should retain recognizable upper dragon outlines and a small ground flare but lose big opaque explosion and rocks; frame10 (bottom second) dragon bodies dissolve into scattered curved fire trails with 75 percent true empty alpha space; frame11 (bottom third) only faint broken ground-ring arcs and 5-8 tiny embers, 92 percent alpha empty; frame12 (bottom right) ONLY three tiny dim amber sparks near the same ground anchor, 99 percent alpha empty, absolutely no big orange cloud. Frame8 (middle right) is the only strong impact peak; keep surrounding dragon faces visible, limit near-white area to the lower central 15 percent of the cell. No text, no borders. This is refined realistic game VFX flame, not flat illustration; preserve shape and mass of the dragons while removing haze only.

prompts.purpose: padding repair, rejected because padding did not improve
prompts.prompt: Precise sprite-sheet repair. Edit this supplied 1448x1086 alpha transparent 4-column by 3-row sheet of Nine Dragon Fire. KEEP the same detailed nine Chinese dragon artwork, all dragon heads and curling bodies, same chronological 12-frame sequence, same warm colors and center anchors. DO NOT redesign or simplify. Fix CELL EDGE CLIPPING ONLY: in EVERY 362x362 cell, ensure the complete visible effect including all glowing rings, sparks and dragon horns is fully contained with 12 pixels of completely transparent padding on ALL FOUR edges of that cell. There must be no flat chopped edge and no sprite or glow bleeding into any neighboring frame. Particularly row2 col4 contact burst and row3 col1 ring must be intact rounded rings, not cut flat at their bottom. Fit composition inward only as much as necessary for this 12px safety margin, no drastic downsizing. Use genuine transparent alpha. No grid, no text. Preserve detail and crisp face/scale contours. Last row gradually dissolves, last cell only small residual ring fragments and tiny embers. Exact 4x3 regular equal square grid, no rearrangement.

Create ONE SINGLE 1024x1024 transparent game VFX keyframe, NOT a sprite sheet. Reference image is the original Nine Dragon Fire animation sheet; match its frame-eight (middle row rightmost) Nine Dragon Fire impact composition. Preserve the recognizable nine Chinese fire dragons rising and intertwining around a sacred golden ground ring, detailed horned heads and curled slender necks like the reference. Keyframe shows the strong ground impact with gold/orange flames and a small white-gold center, but dragon heads and bodies must be distinct above it, not a pinwheel. Polished sharp detailed fantasy game illustration, selective rim highlights, warm dark vermilion interiors, clear alpha gaps between dragons, NOT an orange opaque dome. Crucial framing: entire dragon/fire/ring composition fully visible inside a SQUARE image, with 100 pixels genuinely transparent padding on all four sides. No ring or spark may touch the image edges. The bottom of the golden ring must be fully rounded and intact, not cut off. Central ground anchor at approximately x512 y800, dragons extend up to y120. Real alpha transparency, no scene background, no character, no text, no labels, no grid. Output ONE large isolated VFX keyframe only.
